Body.Content: Azure now supports  G-Series Virtual Machine sizes in US East 2. You can now deploy G-Series Virtual Machines in either US West or US East 2. We will continue to increase G-series support in other regions based on customer demand and usage. Furthermore, note that US East 2 prices are slightly lower than the US West prices. Check it out here!
Body.Markdown:
Azure now supports G-Series Virtual Machine sizes in US East 2. You can now deploy G-Series Virtual Machines in either US West or US East 2. We will continue to increase G-series support in other regions based on customer demand and usage.

Furthermore, note that US East 2 prices are slightly lower than the US West prices. Check it out here !
